name: Glimmer Mantis
lore: A patient insect duelist who earns power through precisely timed guards. Three glowing diamonds show stored Poise. Small damage-over-time ticks cannot charge the guard.

primary.name: Scissor Feint
primary.description: Alternating close scissor cuts. Aim the broad forward arc.

secondary.name: Mirror Guard
secondary.description: A 0.45s timing window blocks one hit of at least 5 damage. Gain one Poise, up to three. Holding the button does not extend the window.

special.name: Glass Verdict
special.description: Three advancing diamond cuts along your aim. Each enemy is hit once: 42 damage plus 10 per stored Poise. Consumes all Poise.

passive: Second Wind: A successful Mirror Guard heals 8 HP, at most once every 6s.

technique.name: Long Scissors
technique.description: Reach 105 and damage 24, but cooldown increases from 0.55s to 0.75s.

final_technique.name: Patient Execution
final_technique.description: Trade advancing cuts for a close sweeping finisher after a visible 0.8s wind-up. 88 damage plus 12 per Poise; 18s cooldown.

attack.name: Patient Execution
attack.description: Wind up for 0.8s, then strike a wide close arc. Consumes Poise. Aim and origin lock when cast.
